CRITICAL.name: data_freshness_breach
CRITICAL.condition: Pipeline not run in more than 24 hours
CRITICAL.message: The data pipeline has not run in over 24 hours, leading to stale data.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and restart the data pipeline immediately.

CRITICAL.name: quality_threshold_violation
CRITICAL.message: Data quality has fallen below the 99.9% threshold, risking erroneous financial insights.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Review data quality issues and take corrective actions to restore quality.

CRITICAL.name: row_count_out_of_bounds
CRITICAL.condition: Row count outside of 17 to 25 range
CRITICAL.message: The row count is outside the expected range of 17 to 25, impacting data completeness.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the row count being out of bounds and address the issue.

WARNING.name: runtime_approaching_limit
WARNING.message: The pipeline runtime is approaching the 120-minute limit, which may delay the dashboard update.
WARNING.recommended_action: Monitor the pipeline runtime and optimize if necessary to avoid delays.

WARNING.name: quality_slightly_below_threshold
WARNING.message: Data quality is slightly below the 99.9% threshold, which may lead to minor inaccuracies.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the slight drop in data quality and take preventive measures.

WARNING.name: merchant_failure_spike
WARNING.condition: One merchant's failure rate spikes above 30%
WARNING.message: A merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%, indicating potential issues.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the merchant's failure rate and address the underlying issues.

INFO.name: new_payment_method_detected
INFO.condition: New payment method seen in the data
INFO.message: A new payment method has been detected in the data.
INFO.recommended_action: Verify the new payment method and update the system if necessary.

INFO.name: row_count_near_bounds
INFO.condition: Daily row count near the lower or upper bounds
INFO.message: The daily row count is near the lower or upper bounds but still within the acceptable range.
INFO.recommended_action: Monitor the row count to ensure it remains within the acceptable range.
